title: C24/34/2014 of Raman Kumar Gupta Vs Harbans Singh Sethi AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
C24 No.37/14
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. Diwan Singh Bisht, Advocate

orders.
